description: Add first-class support for multipart/form-data requests in tRPC Fastify adapters. Enable FormData inputs (like file uploads) to be passed through and processed reliably without JSON parsing. Ensure compatibility with streaming request bodies for proper FormData handling.
functional_requirements: Update Fastify adapter to properly handle FormData content types without attempting JSON parsing
Ensure FormData inputs can be forwarded through the request pipeline while maintaining data integrity
Add end-to-end tests that validate multipart/form-data handling with FormData-based procedures
Maintain compatibility with existing JSON-based request handling while adding FormData support
Ensure the solution works reliably across different versions of underlying dependencies
